title: This stuff really works!!
text: This stuff really works!!. Ok I have had one of these in my bathroom for a week to see how it worked. I live in the woods and when it gets damp out my house has a musty scent. With this in my bathroom, it took out all of the mustiness ! I was impressed at how fresh my bathroom smells because we have had so much rain lately. It says on the package that it is lavender scented but I dont smell it..maybe if you put your nose right there, and that is ok by me, but its on my floor behind the toilet. I wish I had started using this years ago!

product_metadata.title: DampRid Absorber-10.5oz Refillable Absorber Traps Moisture for Fresher, Cleaner Air, 10.5oz cups - 4 pack, Blue, 4 Count
features: DampRid Refillable Moisture Absorbers are convenient 10.5-ounce cups that attract and trap excess moisture out of the air
DampRid eliminates odors by absorbing excess moisture that creates damp, musty smells
Great for use in a bathroom, laundry room, kitchen, closet, home gym, and any space where excess moisture is an issue
Each of the four 10.5-ounce cups lasts up to 60 days, depending on temperature and humidity
To use, remove lid and pour crystals from bag into the top tray of the canister. Once odor absorbing crystals have dissolved, discard water from canister and refill for longer lasting freshness
